name: Discord Notifications
description: Sends notifications to Discord for Drupal events and content changes.
project_description:
The Discord Notifications module seamlessly integrates Drupal with Discord, providing real-time notifications for various site events. It keeps site administrators informed about content changes, user activities, system updates, and security alerts, all within their Discord server.

 Features 
 
 Content Notifications: Instant alerts for new content creation, updates, and deletions. 
 User Activity Tracking: Notifications for new user registrations, logins, and when users are blocked. 
 System Monitoring: Alerts for available Drupal core or module updates and completed cron runs. 
 Security Alerts: Immediate notifications for failed login attempts and password reset requests. 
 Customizable Settings: Flexible configuration to choose which types of notifications to send. 
 Discord Integration: Option to use @here or @everyone mentions in notifications. 
 Visual Distinction: Color-coded embeds for different types of notifications in Discord. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 After installing the Discord Notifications module:

 
 Navigate to Admin » Configuration » System » Discord Notifications . 
 Enter your Discord webhook URL (see below for instructions on creating a webhook). 
 Select which types of notifications you want to enable. 
 Optionally, enable @here or @everyone mentions. 
 Save the configuration. 
 
 To create a Discord webhook:

 
 In your Discord server, go to Server Settings » Integrations » Webhooks. 
 Click "New Webhook" and choose a channel for the notifications. 
 Copy the webhook URL and paste it into the module's configuration page. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 
 Drupal 9, 10, or 11 
 A Discord server with permissions to create webhooks
